page.overview:
Who is Garshon?

Garshon is a found at , where he debates the cause of the ' extinction with his brothers. However, their search for the has not been lucky, so they have decided to rest at the . He wonders why they are wasting time at the Stable, when it would be better to go out and find the skeletons.

When speaks to Garshon's brother, , he can hear the three brothers discussing their theories on the ' extinction. Garshon's theory is that the went extinct due to a sudden drought. Akrah reveals to Link that they have a general idea where the three skeletons can be found, and he asks Link to locate them and bring back. Accepting his request begins the "" .

Garshon requires a of the , located in the . When Link shows him a picture, he is shocked at how good Link is at drawing. He believes it is the evidence he needs to prove his theory about the drought. He encourages Link to help Akrah and with their own pictures. He asserts that Link's pictures will be valuable for his and his brothers' research.

Garshon is very invested in his theory, even panting in his sleep. When Link speaks to him, he reiterates how useful the picture will be to him. He doesn't like rain, but he likes to stay inside and think about during such times.
